source:
A laboratory safety rule requires Mira to keep a containment door closed while a hazardous experiment is running. The rule allows opening it only after the experiment has stopped. A technician is trapped inside and needs urgent medical help. Mira can open the door now to reach the technician, but doing so may expose nearby staff to hazardous fumes. Stopping the experiment first takes ten minutes; the technician may die during that delay.

Should Mira open the door immediately or stop the experiment and wait?

rescue_contrast.rescue_exclusivity: doing so may expose nearby staff to hazardous fumes
rescue_contrast.first_rescue_action: open the door now to reach the technician
rescue_contrast.first_benefit: the technician may die during that delay
rescue_contrast.first_harm: may expose nearby staff to hazardous fumes
rescue_contrast.scene: a containment door closed while a hazardous experiment is running

omission_harm.done: open the door now to reach the technician
omission_harm.omitted: does not open the door now
omission_harm.harm_done: may expose nearby staff to hazardous fumes
omission_harm.harm_omitted: the technician may die during that delay
omission_harm.omitted_hedge: if the action is not done

deontic_rule.governed_action: keep a containment door closed, open it
deontic_rule.exception: only after the experiment has stopped
deontic_rule.sanction: may expose nearby staff to hazardous fumes
